description: Page through Colorado licensees by profession category, license type, status, city or state. Call colorado_license_directory_options first for the valid categories, types and statuses.

licenseCategory.description: A profession category from the options, for example "Electrical".

licenseType.description: A license type code from the options.

state.description: Licensee address state (two letters or full name).

status.description: License status (default Active); "all" for every status.

name: colorado_license_directory
title: Browse Colorado licensees
